annotations.text:
Block height tracks duration, with a floor so a 15-minute shower stays readable.

Empty stretches never take up space — they collapse to one dashed line. Compare Monday (10h 30m) with Wednesday (3h 30m): you can see the difference without reading a word.

Every line parses locally as you type — instant, free, offline.

The last line is one the parser can't read. That's the only kind of line that goes to Claude, and the only kind that costs anything.
A todo is one object in two places. Unscheduled it sits in the right rail; give it a time and it also becomes a block, carrying its checkbox. Tick it anywhere, it ticks everywhere.
Nothing resets on its own. Mark the fixed things — school, gym, swim — as repeating once, and this button clears the rest whenever you're ready to plan.
